paragraphs.text: Mount Fiers is the tallest, most majestic mountain on Dominaria . It lies on Otaria .

With its height, it always catches the first rays of sunrise and the last rays of the sunset each day. The mountain was named after the God of Fire, Fiers , who according to myth created it along with the rest of the mountains on the plane. It was beneath Mount Fiers that the Lady of the Mountain hatched from her great stone egg. Fiers also worked on a magnificent home surrounding the egg: a home for himself, a home for his child. The god of fire built chambers that spanned the entire base of Mount Fiers.
